candidate_title: Same-session breadth of qualified forecast updates as a shared expectation shock
blocker: The frozen contrast (breadth members versus isolated updates) has a structurally starved control cohort: the consensus feed batches qualified updates into daily snapshots, so nearly every qualified decision is a breadth member. Only 8 isolated (1-2 same-direction issuers in a session) decisions exist lifetime versus 1510 breadth-member decisions across 21 decision sessions (~72 decisions per session). Any credible comparison bar (>=30 control decisions) is unreachable under the current feed cadence; this is exactly the unreachable rare-event bar class the 2026-08-28 protocol amendment forbids freezing.
quantitative_reopen_condition: Reopen this parked candidate only when the isolated-control cohort (sessions with 1-2 same-direction qualified mapped issuers) reaches >=30 decisions under an unchanged qualification rule, or when a finer intra-session event clock (true per-update publication times rather than daily batch snapshots) is added to the source contract so that breadth can be defined on real event clustering; redefining the breadth threshold on the same daily-batch clock does not qualify.
notes: The scope itself completed and selected this candidate, so the Phase-2 reopen precondition (a fresh outcome-blind D0-D3 scope that actually selects) is met; the park applies to this candidate's falsification contract, not to the scope. The two D0-D3-passed unselected registrants (cand-1a665d7350fd8d6349e8 exploitation, cand-68d2f5dad2f903488307 adjacent) remain registered in the discovery ledger for a future scope round.
